clue.text: Dash could be a disadvantage

definitions.meaning: a dash is the printed sign for subtraction

explanation.surface: A rush might turn out to be a handicap.
explanation.definitionFit: The subtraction sign is a short horizontal stroke, and a drawback is a negative point against something.

clue.text: Urges for example to compose song

parts.note: EG is the abbreviation of exempli gratia, for example

indicators.note: to compose a song is to put it together, so its letters are arranged anew

explanation.surface: Someone presses an example into service while writing a tune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'compose' turns SONG into GSON, written after EG.
explanation.definitionFit: To spur someone on with encouragement is to drive them forward.

clue.text: A quarter had not paid, being dogged

parts.note: south is one of the four quarters of the compass, abbreviated S
taken as written
money not yet paid is still owed

explanation.surface: A district behind with its payments is pursued by creditors.
explanation.definitionFit: Being shadowed means being followed closely, as a detective tails a suspect.

clue.text: Little beasts pocketing loot can give rise to complaint

indicators.note: the small creatures take the other word into their pocket, so it sits inside them

parts.note: mice are small animals
to loot is to rob

explanation.surface: Small animals stealing goods might cause a fuss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complaint' here means an illness, not a grumble.
explanation.definitionFit: A germ is a tiny organism that can cause disease, an illness also called a complaint.

clue.text: No, it's all arranged, the horse will appear

indicators.note: the words no, it's and all are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: Everything is fixed, and the horse will turn up for the show.
explanation.definitionFit: An uncastrated male horse, kept for breeding.

clue.text: Foreigner receiving the sovereign-he's choked

indicators.note: the foreigner takes in the coin, which then sits inside his name

parts.note: a stranger is someone from elsewhere
a sovereign is a gold pound coin, and L is the pound sign

explanation.surface: An alien being handed the monarch is overcome with emotion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'choked' looks like 'emotional', but the definition means one who has throttled someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A killer who throttles victims is one who has choked them.

clue.text: Placed by the bird table?

parts.note: a seat set beside a table, read as furniture with a bird's flight feather

explanation.surface: Something positioned next to where garden birds are fed.
explanation.walkthrough: The bird table suggests a garden feeder; the bird part is the side panel of a high-backed armchair, and a chair sits by a table.
explanation.definitionFit: A high-backed armchair with projecting side pieces at head height.

clue.text: The condition to maintain

definitions.meaning: the ... of something is its condition
to maintain a view is to assert or declare it

explanation.surface: The terms you must keep to.
explanation.definitionFit: A situation or circumstance; and to declare firmly, as in claiming something is true.

clue.text: A talk written up as a story

indicators.note: in a down clue, written up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to gas is to chatter idly

explanation.surface: A conversation turned into a tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'written up' turns A GAS round to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A long narrative, originally an Old Norse or Icelandic heroic tale.

clue.text: Not the favourite in society?

parts.note: a racing term for a horse unlikely to win, and also one who is not part of the social group

explanation.surface: Someone unpopular among the social set.
explanation.definitionFit: A runner given little chance of winning, and also a person excluded from a community.

clue.text: Circle in the plane above the water

indicators.note: the circle is placed in the middle of the level surface

parts.note: a flat, a level surface or plane
a circle is shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: Looping the loop in an aircraft over the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plane' suggests an aircraft, but it is a flat surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Floating on the surface rather than sinking.

clue.text: Apprehend within a week? No way!

indicators.note: the letters lie within the words that follow, across the joins

explanation.surface: Someone protests that catching anyone in seven days is impossible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Apprehend' suggests arrest, but here it means understand.
explanation.definitionFit: To apprehend a fact is to grasp or understand it.

clue.text: Barges in maybe with the aim of reducing friction

definitions.text: with the aim of reducing friction

indicators.note: maybe says the letters of barges in could form something else

explanation.surface: Boats push their way in, perhaps to ease the strain.
explanation.definitionFit: Ball or roller parts fitted round axles in machines so moving parts turn smoothly.

clue.text: Isn't ill or indisposed a great deal

indicators.note: indisposed means out of sorts, so the letters of isn't ill or are put out of order

explanation.surface: A patient says they are not sick or poorly at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Numbers of a million million, used loosely for an enormous quantity.

clue.text: Chair or soft settle

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction for soft
to settle in a place is to reside there

explanation.surface: Furniture choice: an armchair or a cushioned couch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chair' and 'settle' look like furniture; both are verbs here.
explanation.definitionFit: To chair a meeting is to be in charge of it.

clue.text: Left at home to occupy a relative

indicators.note: the word for at home moves into and occupies the relative

parts.note: a sister is a family relative
someone at home is in

explanation.surface: Someone went off to live in with a family member.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left' reads as departed; it means on the left-hand side.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin for left-hand, used in heraldry for the left side of a shield.

clue.text: A person colouring rope

definitions.meaning: someone who applies paint or colour
a line at the bow of a boat used to tie it up

explanation.surface: Someone dyeing a cord.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist or decorator, and the mooring line on a small boat.

clue.text: Plant a container like this

parts.note: a can is a metal container
thus means in this way

explanation.surface: Instructions to put a pot in the garden in this fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mediterranean herb with spiny leaves, whose shape decorates Corinthian columns.

clue.text: Re-doing puzzle when not given any attention

indicators.note: to puzzle the letters is to jumble them

explanation.surface: Doing a puzzle again when nobody is watching.
explanation.definitionFit: Disregarded, overlooked by everyone.

clue.text: Inclined to hang around a social worker

indicators.note: the word for hang goes around the insect

parts.note: to sling something is to hang it loosely
an ant is a social insect and a worker

explanation.surface: Tempted to loiter near a caseworker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' suggests a job; in crosswords it is an ant.
explanation.definitionFit: Sloping at an angle.

clue.text: Having no work to do, some take unpaid leave

indicators.note: some take says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Workers with nothing on their hands go off without pay.
explanation.definitionFit: Unoccupied, with no job in hand.

clue.text: A mother can be the making of a man

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially a horse

explanation.surface: A mum can make a man of her son.
explanation.walkthrough: Genesis tells of the first man being made from dust.
explanation.definitionFit: The first human in the Bible, created by God from dust.

clue.text: Strike in a recession, as is natural

indicators.note: a recession is a going back, so the letters are read in retreat

parts.note: to lam is to beat or strike
taken as written

explanation.surface: Industrial action during an economic downturn is to be expected.
explanation.definitionFit: Of the body and instinct, physical rather than spiritual.

clue.text: Tea-great for disorder!

parts.note: cha is a slang word for tea
OS is short for outsize, very large

explanation.surface: A tea party ends in a mess.
explanation.definitionFit: Complete confusion or mayhem.

clue.text: Sounds like thrush in mass formation

indicators.note: says the answer is spoken the same as the bird's name

parts.note: the missel thrush, also mistle thrush, is a large European bird

explanation.surface: Birdsong heard among a great flock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mass formation' suggests a crowd; it is the order of the Catholic Mass.
explanation.definitionFit: A book holding the prayers and order of service for the Catholic Mass.

clue.text: Abroad the Conservatives are not subject to restriction

parts.note: someone out is away, abroad
the political right

explanation.surface: Tory politicians overseas cannot be held back.
explanation.definitionFit: Complete and unconditional, as in owning something with no limits.

clue.text: Article, note, and royal letters causing strong feeling

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
G is a musical note
ER, Elizabeth Regina, as on royal post boxes

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece, a memo and a palace letter stir up passion.
explanation.definitionFit: Rage or fury, an intense emotion.

clue.text: Got a ruler replaced-that will keep things right

indicators.note: the letters of got a ruler are put back in another order

explanation.surface: A new monarch was installed to restore order.
explanation.definitionFit: A device or official that controls something to keep it working properly.
